edge.default: on a grid line with a half groove
edge.margin: any edge may carry a declared plain margin of any width; it then forms no groove when butted

corner.rule: solid by default; no groove, half groove or dovetail wall required at a fold; nothing may target the corner; parts crossing a fold hold in the grooves on each face
corner.fold_line: a grid line of both faces; first grid line on each face is 32 from it
maker_may: run plates up to the corner as they are

plate_fixing.reference: one M6 screw through the cell hole; two or more on plates wider than one cell

decided.small_routing: two passes, 3/8 in 14 deg bit at 6.0 deep, second pass shifted 1.47
decided.large_routing: one pass, 1/2 in 14 deg bit at 9.5 deep (opening comes out 7.96)
decided.core_holes: every cell centre on swap bases (SHOULD); other build modes drill what they need
decided.square_edged_plates: conform only once bevelled to 14 deg
decided.claim_line_example: MAV Grid 0.10 · Large · 2 × 2 · Gridfinity plate · Screw fix

multiboard_plate.rule: model from scratch from measured or published dimensions; no geometry from Multiboard files; name used only to say what it fits, no logo, state no affiliation or endorsement
